BatchDeleteRouteStrategy.description_en: Deletes multiple Route Strategies in a batch

BatchDisableJobs.description_en: Disables multiple jobs in a batch

BatchEnableJobs.description_en: Enables multiple jobs at a time

CreateAppGroup.description_en: Creates an app group and returns an AppKey

CreateJob.description_en: Creates a node and returns the node ID

CreateWorkflow.description_en: Creates a workflow. By default, the created workflow is disabled. After you update the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of the workflow, you must manually or call the corresponding operation to enable the workflow. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
CreateWorkflow.description_zh: 创建工作流，默认禁用状态，更新完DAG后，需要手动或者通过API启动用工作流，只有专业版才支持

DescribeRegions.description_en: Returns a list of available regions

ExecuteJob.description_en: Triggers a job to immediately run once
ExecuteJob.description_zh: 触发一次任务立即运行

ExecuteWorkflow.description_zh: 触发一次工作流立即运行

GetAppGroup.description_en: Retrieves the details of an App Group

GetJobInfo.description_en: Queries the details of a job based on the job ID. In most cases, the obtained information is used to update jobs
GetJobInfo.description_zh: 获取指定Jobid任务详情，通常用来更新任务

GetJobInstance.description_en: Returns the information of a job instance, allowing you to view its status and progress
GetJobInstance.description_zh: 返回任务实例的信息，可以查看任务实例的状态和进度

GetJobInstanceList.description_en: Queries the most recent 10 execution instances of a job
GetJobInstanceList.description_zh: 根据关键字过滤，返回任务执行的历史记录

GetLog.description_en: Queries the operational logs of a job. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
GetLog.description_zh: 通过该API可以查询任务的运行日志，需要开通专业版才支持

GetOverview.description_en: Retrieves the overview data of task scheduling for a professional edition application
GetOverview.description_zh: 获取专业版应用任务调度概览数据信息

GetWorkerList.description_en: Obtains the list of workers that are connected to an application
GetWorkerList.description_zh: 获取接入某个应用的worker列表

GetWorkflowInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified workflow instance, including the state of the workflow instance, the state of each job instance, and the dependencies between job instances. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
GetWorkflowInstance.description_zh: 获取指定工作流实例的详情，包含实例状态，依赖关系，每个任务实例的状态等。专业版应用才支持

GrantPermission.description_en: Grants permissions to an application group

ListJobScriptHistory.description_en: Queries historical scripts of a job
ListJobScriptHistory.description_zh: 获取任务脚本历史列表

ListWorkFlows.description_en: Queries the information of a workflow

ListWorkflowInstance.description_en: Queries the execution history of a workflow. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
ListWorkflowInstance.description_zh: 获取工作流的历史执行记录，只有专业版才支持

ReadSchedulerxCalendar.description_en: Retrieves the information of a calendar

ReadSchedulerxDesignateDetail.description_en: Queries detailed information of the workers specified by a job
ReadSchedulerxDesignateDetail.description_zh: 获取任务指定的机器详细信息

ReadSchedulerxDesignateInfo.description_en: Retrieves basic information for the specified instance
ReadSchedulerxDesignateInfo.description_zh: 获取指定的机器基本信息

RerunJob.description_en: Reruns a job to obtain the historical data of the job. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
RerunJob.description_zh: 重跑任务的历史数据，只有专业版才支持

RetryJobInstance.description_en: Reruns a node instance in the failed or successful state. Only the professional edition supports this operation
RetryJobInstance.description_zh: 重跑失败或者成功状态的任务实例，只有专业版才支持

RevokePermission.description_en: Revokes the permissions that are granted to an Alibaba Cloud Resource Access Management (RAM) user
RevokePermission.description_zh: 取消指定阿里云子账号的权限

SetJobInstanceSuccess.description_en: Forcibly sets the instance status of a node to successful. Only the professional edition supports this operation
SetJobInstanceSuccess.description_zh: 强制设置任务实例状态为成功状态，只有专业版才支持

SetWfInstanceSuccess.description_en: Forcibly sets the state of a workflow instance to successful. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
SetWfInstanceSuccess.description_zh: 强制设置工作流实例状态为成功状态，只有专业版才支持

StopInstance.description_en: Stops a job instance in the running state
StopInstance.description_zh: 终止某次正在运行的实例

UpdateJob.description_en: Updates the configuration of a node. By default, call the get node operation first to find the corresponding fields to modify
UpdateJob.description_zh: 更新任务配置信息。默认先调用获取任务找到对应字段进行修改

UpdateJobScript.description_en: Updates the execution script of a job

UpdateWorkflow.description_en: Updates the basic information about a workflow. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
UpdateWorkflow.description_zh: 更新工作流的基本信息，只有专业版才支持

UpdateWorkflowDag.description_en: Updates the nodes and dependencies of a workflow. This operation is available only in the Enterprise Edition
UpdateWorkflowDag.description_zh: 更新工作流的节点及依赖关系，专业版应用才支持
